title: Sandbox Extension Approval
description: Vendor approval for the sandbox extensions in a git repository. One approval covers a whole repository: consolidation publishes every extension under tools/ (kind: sandbox) and features/ (kind: mixin) as its own entry.

sandboxExtensionId.description: Identifier prefix for the repository, in reverse-domain notation (e.g., io.github.eclipse-enclave/enclave-extensions). Each published extension appends its repository path, giving ids like io.github.eclipse-enclave/enclave-extensions/tools/openclaw. Use a prefix that names the repository, not just the owner, so two kit repositories from one owner can't collide.

source.description: The git repository holding the sandbox extensions. There is no path: extensions are found by convention at tools/* and features/*.

url.description: Git repository URL containing the sandbox extensions

ref.description: Git tag or branch to read and hash instead of the default branch. Omit to follow the default branch, which is also what `enclave add` does when given no --ref.
